## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check src tests` clean
- [ ] `mypy --strict src` clean
- [ ] `pytest -q` green (note any new/changed tests)
- [ ] Conventional-commit title (`feat:` / `fix:` / `docs:` / `refactor:` / `chore:` / `style:`)
- [ ] If `methodology/` changed: `preregistration_v*.md` updated with a `revision_reason`
      (clean vs data-informed) — the §0 discipline
- [ ] README / docs updated if user-facing behaviour changed
